We are looking for a passionate and curious AI/ML Developer to join our team and work on next-generation Generative AI, Agentic AI, and LLM-based applications. This role is ideal for freshers or candidates with internship experience who have hands-on exposure to Python, LLMs, RAG, LangChain, and LangGraph and are eager to build real-world AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and integrate LLM-powered applications and AI solutions using Python.
Build Agentic AI workflows and AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain.
Develop RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines for knowledge-based applications.
Work with LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and AI APIs.
Design and develop AI/ML prototypes and convert them into scalable applications.
Experiment with different LLM models, tools, agents, and orchestration techniques.
Integrate AI capabilities with existing applications and APIs.
Perform testing, debugging, optimization, and continuous improvement of AI solutions.
Stay updated with emerging trends in Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, and AI development frameworks.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand requirements and deliver AI-driven solutions.

Required Skills

Strong programming skills in Python.
Understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Hands-on knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
Exposure to LangChain and LangGraph.
Understanding of Agentic AI / AI Agents and agent workflows.
Knowledge of APIs, REST APIs, JSON, and basic software development concepts.
Familiarity with embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and LLM APIs is preferred.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Good understanding of software development fundamentals.

Good to Have

Internship or academic project experience in GenAI / LLM / Agentic AI.
Exposure to vector databases such as FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone, or similar.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub and basic cloud platforms.
Knowledge of ML/NLP fundamentals.
Experience building and deploying AI/LLM-based projects.

Eligibility

B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science Engineering (CSE) or a related discipline.
0-1 years of experience, including relevant internship experience.
Candidates with strong academic or personal projects in GenAI, LLM, RAG, or Agentic AI are encouraged to apply.
Candidates must be comfortable working 5 days a week from our Gurgaon office.
